title: West Valley City 2025 Moderate Income Housing Plan (General Plan appendix; MIH element per 10-9a-403)
notes: THE MIH ELEMENT OF RECORD. Standalone 22-page born-digital PDF (Acrobat PDFMaker; text layer present) published as an appendix to the General Plan. Cites Utah Code 10-9a-403(2)(a)(iii); uses 2023 ACS data; West Valley has a fixed-guideway transit station (West Valley Central / Fairbourne Station) so it must adopt the extra station-area-plan strategy (Strategy U). Includes the statutory implementation plan and a five-year realistic-opportunity analysis (~725 MIH units anticipated). Adopting resolution/ordinance is referenced in the 2025 state report only as a SharePoint personal link (not publicly fetchable). Sidecar text/wvc-2025-moderate-income-housing-plan.txt.
